component.name: XGC2 STT Client
component.summary: Tray client for a self-hosted streaming speech-to-text API

description.p: Connects a Linux desktop (X11 or Wayland) to a streaming speech-recognition service selected by the user. The application lives in the status area, provides a configurable global shortcut or CLI toggle, live revision preview, and focused text insertion with a clipboard fallback.
No service address or credential is bundled with the application.
